name: Ortolan
description: Ortolans were a sentient elephantine species of squat, blue-skinned bipeds with large, floppy ears, beady black eyes, and a trunk-like nose that were native to the cold planet Orto. They consumed large amounts of food in order to develop a warm layer of blubber due to the frigid temperatures of their homeworld. Maximilian Rebo, founder of the Max Rebo Band, was a male Ortolan.
